data.one_liner: Adds push notification support for Stream Video calls and live-streaming.
data.what_it_does: Provides push notification and ringing integration for Stream Video applications on Android and iOS. It manages incoming call screens, telecom integrations, and VoIP push handling.
use_when: You are building a video call, audio room, or livestream app using Stream Video.
You need push notifications and ringing integration for incoming calls.
avoid_when: You are not using the Stream Video service.
You only need generic local or push notifications unrelated to video calls.
strengths: Native Android Telecom integration and iOS CallKit integration.
Handles cold starts and background VoIP pushes reliably.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Stream Video ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires APN and Firebase configuration, plus native permissions like MANAGE_OWN_CALLS on Android.
